leadText:
Flamel (Japanese: フラメル Flamel) is a minor supporting character who appeared in Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel. She is Kimia's personal assistant.

When arrived at the Azoth Kingdom, Flamel deduced from witness reports that the Pokémon that had appeared was a Volcanion and relayed this to Kimia. She was later seen walking along with Kimia as the latter questioned Raleigh about what he was up to.

Later, after Alva captured , Flamel contacted Kimia and informed her that she had found some diagrams by Nikola in Raleigh's room, which had never been seen before. She explained that Alva intended to use the to activate the hidden mechanisms within the castle, which allowed part of the castle wall to convert into a flying fortress.

At the end of the movie, was seen proposing to Flamel on 's behalf.
